title: The Cozy Blue Parka Holiday Errands Outfit
description: A cozy winter errands outfit from Walmart: a denim-blue sherpa-lined parka, a blush cable knit sweater, moss corduroy wide-leg pants, pink New Balance 550 sneakers, a navy pom beanie and a pink gingerbread quilted tote.
intro: Holiday errand season is here, which means I live in a parka, a sweater and whatever shoes are by the door. This is the version I actually like looking at: a denim-blue sherpa-lined parka over a blush cable knit, moss green cords and pink New Balance 550s. The pink gingerbread quilted tote holds a wrapped gift, my coffee and approximately four receipts. Cozy, cute, and still fine for the post office line.

sections.heading: The parka does the heavy lifting
paragraphs: A denim-blue hooded parka with a sherpa lining, deep flap pockets and a drawstring hood. It goes over everything and it is warm without being a sleeping bag.

sections.heading: Soft colours underneath
paragraphs: An icy blush cotton cable knit crewneck and aged moss corduroy wide-leg pants. Pink, green and blue together look so much more fun than the usual all-black errand uniform.

sections.heading: Shoes, hat and the tote everyone asks about
paragraphs: Pink and white New Balance 550 sneakers, a navy pom beanie and the pink marshmallow gingerbread quilted tote, which is big enough for gifts, groceries and a laptop.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The rooms, street and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
